verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents most of the pieces this story needs. `pulumi preview` shows planned changes without applying them, which gives a plan step. Pulumi Policies enforces guardrails as code, and policy violations surface in pull request comments and checks, which acts as a review gate. ESC can serve as an OIDC provider that issues short-lived tokens, so the agent never needs long-lived credentials. Marketing also says Neo has 'enterprise controls built in' and that agents won't 'go off the rails'. Missing for 10: no documented approval workflow that blocks an agent's apply until a human signs off; no explicit least-privilege scoping of agent credentials (short-lived tokens are not the same as minimal permissions); no detail on how Neo's controls work; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
